retained_code_acceptance_packets.title: HAL, CMSIS, startup assembly, linker, clock tree, and MMIO retained-code packet
retained_code_acceptance_packets.rationale: Retained startup, linker, clock, MMIO, DMA, interrupt, HAL, and CMSIS code controls hardware boot and board access.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.residual_risk: Hardware startup behavior remains blocked until maintainer review accepts the retained packet or approves an exception.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.blocker_or_deferred_action: Collect final hardware evidence and maintainer disposition.

retained_code_acceptance_packets.title: FreeRTOS runtime and synchronization retained-code packet
retained_code_acceptance_packets.rationale: FreeRTOS scheduling and synchronization remain retained runtime code and gate final demotion.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.residual_risk: Scheduler and synchronization behavior remains pending until packet acceptance or exception approval.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.blocker_or_deferred_action: Collect simulator, hardware, and maintainer review evidence for runtime primitives.

retained_code_acceptance_packets.title: Marlin C++ print core retained reference-oracle packet
retained_code_acceptance_packets.rationale: Marlin remains the retained print-core reference oracle until cutover evidence and explicit decision input approve demotion.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.residual_risk: Print behavior parity cannot be claimed from local source validation alone.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.blocker_or_deferred_action: Collect final simulator, hardware, and release evidence before maintainer decision.

retained_code_acceptance_packets.title: LwIP, mbedTLS, WUI, Connect, and transfer retained-code packet
retained_code_acceptance_packets.rationale: Network, TLS, WUI, Connect, and transfer code crosses credential and live-service trust boundaries.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.residual_risk: Live-service evidence and redaction review remain required before acceptance.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.blocker_or_deferred_action: Review Phase 16 evidence and reject any credential or payload material.

retained_code_acceptance_packets.title: FatFs, littlefs, libsysbase, and persistent-store retained-code packet
retained_code_acceptance_packets.rationale: Filesystem, media, and persistent-store retained code controls release resources and durable settings.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.residual_risk: Media behavior and stored configuration compatibility remain pending hardware and maintainer evidence.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.blocker_or_deferred_action: Review Phase 15 media evidence and retained-code packet disposition.

retained_code_acceptance_packets.title: TinyUSB and USB media retained-code packet
retained_code_acceptance_packets.rationale: USB media behavior depends on retained TinyUSB and filesystem integration.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.residual_risk: USB stack and media behavior remain pending hardware evidence and review.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.blocker_or_deferred_action: Review removable-media evidence and maintainer disposition.

retained_code_acceptance_packets.title: Generated assets, resources, translation fonts, and ESP package retained-code packet
retained_code_acceptance_packets.rationale: Generated resources and package inputs must remain traceable without claiming byte identity from local quick artifacts.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.residual_risk: Generated output parity remains pending Phase 17 release evidence.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.blocker_or_deferred_action: Review release artifact evidence and retained resource pipeline disposition.

retained_code_acceptance_packets.title: Release signing, packaging, build selection, and provenance retained-code packet
retained_code_acceptance_packets.rationale: Release signing and packaging depend on external evidence and must not expose key material.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.residual_risk: Signing and package provenance remain blocked until Phase 17 evidence and maintainer review are accepted.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.blocker_or_deferred_action: Review release artifact and signing evidence without storing private material.

retained_code_acceptance_packets.title: MMU, Modbus, puppies, and auxiliary-controller retained-code packet
retained_code_acceptance_packets.rationale: Auxiliary controllers and Modbus/MMU support remain retained and require product-specific evidence.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.residual_risk: Auxiliary behavior remains blocked until hardware and maintainer evidence is accepted.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.blocker_or_deferred_action: Review Phase 15 auxiliary-controller scenarios and packet decision input.

retained_code_acceptance_packets.title: Runtime shell, crash dump, watchdog, panic, and mutable-static retained-code packet
retained_code_acceptance_packets.rationale: Crash dump, watchdog, panic, mutable static, and runtime shell boundaries are safety-relevant retained code.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.residual_risk: Runtime safety demotion remains blocked until hardware evidence and maintainer decision input are accepted.
retained_code_acceptance_packets.blocker_or_deferred_action: Review safety evidence and retained runtime boundary disposition.
